title: Solving the Dirichlet problem with prescribed density
summary: In this paper we prove the following result. Let $Ω\subset\mathbb R^n, n\geq 3,$ be a bounded, strictly convex, smooth domain and $\varphi: \partialΩ\rightarrow\mathbb R$ be a smooth function. Then for any $z\inΩ,$ there exists $c_1=c_1(Ω, \{z\}, n, \varphi)>0,$ such that if $c\geq c_1$ then the problem: $σ_{n-1}(D^2 u)=0$ in $\barΩ\setminus\{z\},$ $u|_{\partialΩ}=\varphi,$ $\lim\limits_{r\rightarrow 0}\sup\limits_{B_r(z)}\frac{u(x)-u(z)}{|x-z|^{(n-2)/(n-1)}}=c,$ admits a smooth solution in $\barΩ\setminus\{z\}.$ Moreover, we obtain the optimal a priori estimates for this solution.
